hypothesis: The exact fixed-half-support mask representation can encode Qwen3.8-27B vision FC2 rows with 33 full 128-wide groups plus one 80-wide tail at exactly 1.5 raw bits per weight, round-trip exactly, and execute the 1152-by-4304 GEMV on one x86 core at no less than half the logical throughput of a padded aligned-two-bit AVX2 control

scope.claim_boundary: synthetic-code codec and base GEMV on the real vision FC2 shape only; not a learned-hash tail fusion, real-weight quality, capability, token-throughput, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

representation.group_layout: width support bits followed by width-over-two support-ordered sign bits and canonical zero terminal padding
representation.full_group_compatibility: byte-identical to the separately frozen mask64 layout
representation.padded_control: aligned two-bit 4352-wide matrix with 48 zero weight and activation coordinates; scale group count remains 34

measurement.codes: deterministic synthetic exact-half-support codes in every full and tail group
measurement.activation: deterministic signed INT8 with 34 per-group FP32 scales and zero-padded control tail
measurement.weight_scales: per-row FP16 anchors plus packed 4-bit per-group FP16-ratio indices
measurement.threading: one process pinned to one physical CPU; kernels are single-threaded
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native

promotion_rules: the codec must round-trip the entire synthetic 1152-by-4304 matrix exactly
the first 128-wide group must remain byte-compatible with mask64
the padded control must use identical logical codes scales and activation with zeros only beyond coordinate 4304
every frozen correctness codec and performance threshold must pass
a pass closes the tail representation and base-kernel feasibility gap only
learned-hash correction fusion for the tail remains a separate requirement
a failed gate is a valid terminal result requiring a separately versioned optimization
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this benchmark cannot establish semi-lossless compression or a scientific breakthrough
